description: Every format-1 golden or pinned value of this repository and its format-2 value (ITL-898, hash format bump 00 00 01 -> 00 00 02). Every value moves. Entries with format2_vector refer to tests/golden/format2_v0.5.json (same input). format1_defects lists the format-1 information losses that affected that input (byte-layout spec Section 10).
